stock.description: Wuhan YZY Biopharma Co., Ltd. is a biotechnology enterprise specializing in the development of bispecific antibody-based treatments. Its therapeutic focus areas include various cancers, their associated complications, and age-related ophthalmic conditions. The company's extensive portfolio of drug candidates aims to address a wide range of diseases, such as malignant ascites, malignant pleural effusion, various solid tumors (including pancreatic cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, other advanced solid tumors, and HER2-positive solid tumors), small cell lung cancer, and relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Additionally, they are advancing therapies for COVID-19 and several eye disorders like wet age-related macular degeneration (wAMD), diabetic macular edema (DME), and other conditions characterized by abnormal blood vessel formation in the eye. The company, established in 2010, is headquartered in Wuhan, China.
